prompts.title: Chocolate
prompts.promptText: A realistic shot of a chocolate fondant lava cake on a wooden platter, dusted with icing sugar and a mint garnish. Warm liquid chocolate flows out onto the board with a spoon. Set on a dark wooden table with two glowing candles and a brick wall background in soft focus. Atmospheric cozy lighting, rich colors, ultra-realistic.

prompts.title: Cheese Cake
prompts.promptText: A realistic shot of a slice of cheesecake on a black plate, with thick blueberry sauce being poured from a gold spoon. Set on a dark grey textured table with scattered fresh blueberries. Gold forks, spoons, and a brass holder are visible in the blurry background. Moody cinematic lighting, rich details, commercial dessert styling, ultra-realistic.

prompts.title: Asian Hotpot
prompts.promptText: Professional food photography of a large, bubbling Asian hot pot or shabu-shabu feast, eye-level shot. A massive black metal pot sits in the center on a portable stove with visible glowing orange flames underneath. Inside the pot, a rich, simmering dark broth is divided, packed with thinly sliced beef, pork, broccoli florets, mushrooms, green onions, and fresh vegetables, with thick white steam rising dramatically from the center. Surrounding the main pot on a dark surface are numerous small black bowls filled with side dishes, dipping sauces, raw garlic bulbs, sliced chilies, and fresh greens. Dark background, dramatic and intense studio lighting focusing on the rising steam and the fiery glow under the pot. Photorealistic, 8k resolution, highly detailed, commercial food styling.

prompts.title: Mala Hotpot
prompts.promptText: Top-down flat lay food photography of a vibrant Chinese Shabu-Shabu or Mala Hot Pot feast spread across a light wooden table. In the center, a large stainless steel split pot filled with two types of simmering broths: a fiery red spicy mala broth with star anise on one side, and a clear, golden herbal broth with shiitake mushrooms on the other. Densely surrounding the central pot are numerous square plastic trays in alternating bright red and black colors. The trays showcase an abundant variety of raw ingredients: thinly sliced marbled beef, rolled pork belly, raw minced meat topped with egg yolks, fresh mussels, crab sticks, fish balls, enoki mushrooms, glass noodles, and green leafy vegetables. Clean, bright, and even studio lighting that accentuates the fresh textures and rich colors of the ingredients. Photorealistic, 8k resolution, commercial food styling look.

prompts.title: Korean Food
prompts.promptText: A realistic Korean food feast set on a dark textured marble table, top-down angled shot. Includes a steaming bowl of red spicy kimchi stew in a black stone pot, a plate of neatly arranged sliced pork belly, a bowl of white rice, and two small dishes of fresh kimchi. Minimalist black tableware, dramatic overhead studio lighting, rich colors, high contrast, commercial food styling look, ultra-realistic.
